name: Reshipment IP67 Outdoor 868MHz Cavity Filter for Helium & LoRaWAN | ≥55dB Rejection | ≤1.0dB Loss | N-Female
description: DESCRIPTION Ensure maximum reliability for your European outdoor IoT deployment with the ACASOM IP67 Outdoor 868MHz Cavity Filter. Engineered for the 863-870MHz LoRaWAN and Helium Network band, this rugged filter is built to withstand harsh environments while delivering critical interference protection. It features ultra-low insertion loss (≤1.0dB) and provides exceptional out-of-band rejection (≥55dB at 853MHz and 880MHz), effectively blocking strong adjacent signals from cellular and other RF services. Housed in a weatherproof, black aluminum enclosure with N-Female connectors, it is designed for permanent, high-performance outdoor installation between your antenna and hotspot miner or amplifier. Why a High Out-of-Band Rejection Filter is Essential The primary function of a filter is to eliminate interference signals. Therefore, the higher the out-of-band rejection and the closer this performance is to your operating frequency, the better. A filter that does not clearly specify this parameter is misleading; without significant rejection, it functions merely as a transmission line (offering low loss but no protection). Our filter is defined by its benchmark specifications, providing the definitive shielding your network requires for stable, long-range operation. ABOUT CONNECTIONS The filter is bidirectional. Both RF ports are identical and can be connected to either the antenna or the miner. For optimal performance, install the filter in-line on the coaxial cable, between the antenna and the Helium hotspot miner, or between the antenna and an extender. KEY FEATURES Full Band Coverage: Optimized for the complete 863-870MHz EU LoRaWAN and Helium ISM band. Superior Interference Blocking: High out-of-band rejection cleans your signal, improving network stability and data integrity. Maximum Signal Efficiency: Ultra-low 1.0dB insertion loss preserves your valuable RF signal strength. Rugged Outdoor Design: IP67-rated housing protects against dust and water ingress for permanent outdoor use. Universal Compatibility: Ideal for enhancing Helium Network hotspots and all 868MHz LoRa IoT gateway applications. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Parameter Specification Details / Benefit Target Applications LoRa ISM, RFID, Helium Miner Perfect for key EU IoT & blockchain networks. Operating Bandwidth 863 - 870 MHz Full 7MHz bandpass for standard compliance. Insertion Loss ≤ 1.0 dB Ultra-low loss maximizes signal power transmission. VSWR ≤ 1.2 Excellent impedance matching for minimal reflection. Power Handling 20 Watts High power rating ensures reliability. Out-of-Band Rejection ≥ 55 dB @ 100-853MHz ≥ 55 dB @ 880-2700MHz Exceptional suppression of wideband interference. Connectors N-Type (N-Female) Robust, standard connectors for outdoor cabling.
